test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Choose the box that is not similar to the box formed from the given sheet of paper when it is folded.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9a6ef6ce267ec317cadd85d8fc95ab3c878ac707b525e50d51ef7a584852bd0.png]
solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

In the given figure, Opposite faces are :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d802ac800123c09be788a60312c28282121b87ae421f265ce5af2bf969b479d.png] 

1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b469429e237149284667fe2aed2ca2c4eb38f83f68400539a8da40b9db80574.png] → The shaded is arranged according to folding.

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/492744a4d04566dc80eadaa351ed08f47710240d3a9e365addd9c7a6533d4bc5.png] → The shaded is arranged according to folding.

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/516206bad37424de77094a6a1ae840c5ba26d534dc8c9dfc1d951507a52fad0f.png] → **The shaded part should be on side of 3 according to folding.**

4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e4e56d73ec68508fa3dea791e9e6cca533c99ad213922d5c8893673c4937011.png] → The shaded is arranged according to folding.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
